name: Smart Lamp Midi
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A configurable lamp: a USB LEDs module for light, an LED Button for brightness (five levels and off) and mode, a knob for colour, and a buzzer for confirmation sounds. Hold the button for a second to switch to sundown mode — the lamp then fades gently to off over 30 minutes whenever it is on. Remembers its last setting.
assembly_guide: Connect the USB LEDs module to the DataHub, and the DataHub to the PicoHub.
Connect the LED Button, the Knob and the Buzzer to the PicoHub I2C ports.
Run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: Switch mode: light ↔ sundown. Sundown: the lamp fades to off over 30 minutes whenever it is on
Shows the lamp colour while on. After a mode switch: breathes 3× = sundown, steady = light
Clicks per brightness step, a low tone for off, a short melody for sundown
Factory reset — keep holding until the LED flashes, goes dark and the buzzer sounds (about 8 s)

config_schema.label: Brightness
config_schema.help: The button steps through 5 levels; set any value here.

config_schema.label: Lamp colour
config_schema.help: The knob steps through 64 preset colours; pick any colour here.

config_schema.help: Sundown: the lamp fades to off whenever it is on. Hold the button for one second to switch.
